reward: 2*x-x*x/2; all inputs exact rational and synthetic

mip.note: Each envelope and each timed tree receive a separate three-second solve allowance. The two envelopes together receive six seconds, not three. Wall time includes formulation for MIP; tree stops between atomic calls. No universal speed claim.

population_policy: Keep every specified case and every interrupted result. Reuse saved cases only if the protocol hash agrees. No instance selection based on outcomes.
relative_gap: (upper-lower)/max(abs(lower),abs(upper),1/1000000); values near zero retain an explicit normalization floor
